name: @orderly.network/mcp-server

tools.name: search_orderly_docs
tools.description: Search Orderly Network documentation for specific topics, concepts, or questions

query.description: Search query about Orderly Network (e.g., 'how does the vault work', 'trading fees', 'order types')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

scope.description: Which corpus to search: 'sdk' for type-accurate SDK symbols (hooks/components/types/functions), 'docs' for protocol documentation, or 'auto' (default) which detects intent from the query (camelCase/use* names → SDK, plain language → docs)

detail.description: 'summary' (default) truncates long documentation sections to keep responses compact; 'full' returns complete section text

tools.name: get_contract_addresses
tools.description: Get smart contract addresses for Orderly on specific chains

contractType.description: Contract type (e.g., 'vault', 'usdc', 'usdt') or 'all' for all contracts

tools.name: explain_workflow
tools.description: Get step-by-step explanation of common Orderly development workflows

workflow.description: Workflow topic, name fragment, or natural-language description (e.g., 'wallet connection', 'deposit', 'setting up react sdk', 'placing orders'). Matches are fuzzy — partial words and multi-word queries work.

tools.name: get_api_info
tools.description: Get information about Orderly REST API endpoints or WebSocket streams

tools.name: get_indexer_api_info
tools.description: Get information about Orderly Indexer API for trading metrics, account events, trades, and volume statistics (rankings endpoints available via endpoint search)

category.description: Filter by category (e.g., 'trading_metrics', 'events::events_api', 'trades::trades_api', 'trading_metrics::volume_statistic') - use instead of endpoint to see all endpoints in a category

tools.name: get_component_guide
tools.description: Get guidance on building React UI components using Orderly SDK

tools.name: get_orderly_one_api_info
tools.description: Get information about Orderly One API for DEX creation, graduation, and management

tools.name: get_strategy_vault_api_info
tools.description: Get information about Orderly Strategy Vault API for yield optimization, strategy providers, and liquidity providers

category.description: Filter by category (e.g., 'strategy_vault_info', 'strategy_provider', 'fund_management', 'liquidity_provider', 'user') - use instead of endpoint to see all endpoints in a category

tools.name: get_public_info_api_info
tools.description: Get information about the Orderly Public Info API — a zero-auth single endpoint (POST /v1/public/query) for market, account, and platform data via a `type` field. Covers 24 query types (marketSummary, accountState, orderbook, candles, topAddresses, etc.)

queryType.description: Query type name (e.g., "marketSummary", "accountState", "orderbook", "candles", "topAddresses", "whaleContext"). Returns full details: params, response fields, example, weight, freshness.

category.description: Browse a category instead: "market", "account", "platform", or "system". Use instead of queryType to list all types in a category.
